scripts.dev: node ../../scripts/run-with-env.mjs --env required --scope backend --profile development -- pnpm dev:raw
scripts.start: node ../../scripts/run-with-env.mjs --env optional --scope backend --profile production -- uv run uvicorn asterism.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.test: node ../../scripts/run-with-env.mjs --env none --scope backend --profile test -- uv run pytest -q
scripts.init:db: node ../../scripts/run-with-env.mjs --env required --scope backend --profile backend-init -- uv run python -m asterism.db.init_db
scripts.reset:db: node ../../scripts/run-with-env.mjs --env required --scope backend --profile reset -- uv run python -m asterism.db.init_db --reset
scripts.reset:db:confirmed: node ../../scripts/run-with-env.mjs --env required --scope backend --profile reset -- uv run python -m asterism.db.init_db --reset --yes
